items.title: 6.5 Reaction ki enthalpy tabdeeli aur kimiyai bonds (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.5, printed page 123.

blocks.text: Kimiyai reaction woh amal hai jis mein purane bonds tootte aur naye bante hain, to reaction ki enthalpy tabdeeli kimiyai bonds ke tootne aur banne se aati hai. Kimiyai bond energy ki ek shakal hai, kimiyai energy, jo doosri sab shaklon mein badal sakti hai. Bond tootna energy jazb karta hai (delta H musbat) aur bond banna use kharij karta hai (delta H manfi), aur un ka farq kul nishan tai karta hai: reaction exothermic hai agar naye bonds banne mein kharij energy purane torne mein jazb se zyada ho, warna endothermic. Pani ke banne mein H-H bonds aur O=O bonds torne ke liye energy chahiye jabke H-O bonds banne mein energy kharij hoti hai, aur kul reaction exothermic hai kyunke jazb se zyada kharij hoti hai: 2H2(g) + O2(g) se 2H2O(g), delta Hr manfi.

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.1: H2 + 1/2 O2 se H2O(g)

blocks.prompt: CH4 + 2O2 se CO2 + 2H2O(g) ke liye toote aur bane bonds ginein aur Table 6.1 se delta H ka andaza lagayein (C-H 413, O=O 498, C=O 728, O-H 463).
blocks.explanation: Toote: chaar C-H (4 x 413 = 1652) aur do O=O (2 x 498 = 996), kul 2648 kJ jazb. Bane: do C=O (2 x 728 = 1456) aur chaar O-H (4 x 463 = 1852), kul 3308 kJ kharij. Delta H = 2648 - 3308 = -660 kJ fi mol, exothermic (ausat qeematein andaza deti hain; napi hui qeemat taqreeban -800 hai).

items: Delta Hr = reactant bonds torne mein jazb energy - product bonds banne mein kharij energy = sum ER - sum EP; zyada kharij hone par exothermic (pani banna: 683.5 - 926 = -242.5 kJ fi mol).
